work out: After arguing for an hour, the two friends sat down calmly and tried to work out their problem together.
爭吵了一個小時後，那兩個朋友冷靜坐下來，試著一起解決他們的問題。
work against: Being late to every class will work against you when teachers write your recommendation letters for college.
每堂課都遲到，在老師幫你寫大學推薦信時會對你不利。
work one's way up: My uncle started as a waiter, but he managed to work his way up to restaurant manager in ten years.
我叔叔從服務生做起，但他十年內一步步往上爬，當上了餐廳經理。
work a miracle: The doctors had to work a miracle to save the boy after the terrible accident on the highway.
那場高速公路的嚴重車禍後，醫生們必須創造奇蹟才能救活那個男孩。
work on a project: Our team will work on a project about plastic pollution, so we meet in the library every Friday.
我們小組要進行一個關於塑膠污染的專案，所以每週五都在圖書館碰面。
work through problems: A good counselor helps students work through problems step by step instead of just telling them what to do.
好的輔導老師會幫助學生一步一步解決問題，而不是只告訴他們該怎麼做。
work up an appetite: We hiked up the mountain all morning, so we really worked up an appetite before lunch.
我們整個早上都在爬山，所以午餐前真的餓了。
worship money: Some people worship money so much that they forget to spend time with their family and friends.
有些人太崇拜金錢，以致於忘了花時間陪伴家人和朋友。
hero worship: Young fans often show a kind of hero worship toward famous athletes and copy everything they do.
年輕的粉絲常對知名運動員表現出一種英雄崇拜，模仿他們做的每件事。
worship the ground someone walks on: Her little brother adores her and seems to worship the ground she walks on.
她的弟弟非常愛她，似乎對她崇拜至極。
a place of worship: Please speak quietly and take off your hat when you enter a place of worship such as a temple.
進入像寺廟這樣的禮拜場所時，請小聲說話並脫下帽子。
be worth the effort: Learning a new language takes years, but it will be worth the effort when you travel abroad.
學一種新語言需要好幾年，但當你出國旅行時，這會是值得努力的。
worth one's salt: Any teacher worth his salt knows that students learn better when they feel safe in class.
任何稱職的老師都知道，學生在課堂上感到安心時學得更好。
worth a try: I'm not sure this new medicine will stop my cough, but it is worth a try.
我不確定這種新藥能不能止住我的咳嗽，但值得一試。
for all one is worth: When the bus started to leave, she ran after it for all she was worth and finally caught it.
公車開始開走時，她竭盡全力追在後面，最後終於趕上了。
worth one's while: If you help me move these boxes this weekend, I will make it worth your while with a nice dinner.
如果你這個週末幫我搬這些箱子，我會請你吃頓好吃的晚餐，讓你覺得值得。
wrap up a meeting: The manager tried to wrap up the meeting by five o'clock so everyone could go home on time.
經理試著在五點前結束會議，好讓大家都能準時回家。
wrap up a deal: After weeks of long talks, the two companies hope to wrap up a deal worth millions of dollars by Friday.
經過數週的漫長談判，兩家公司希望在星期五前完成一筆價值數百萬美元的交易。
be wrapped up in work: He was so wrapped up in work that he forgot it was his own birthday until his wife called.
他全心投入工作，直到妻子打電話來才想起那天是他自己的生日。
wrap one's head around: I read the math problem three times, but I still couldn't wrap my head around it.
那道數學題我讀了三遍，但還是無法理解。
under wraps: The singer kept her new album under wraps until the day it was released online.
那位歌手把她的新專輯保密，直到線上發行那天才公開。
wrap a gift: Could you help me wrap a gift for my mom? I'm terrible at folding the paper neatly.
你可以幫我包一份給我媽媽的禮物嗎？我很不會把包裝紙摺整齊。
wrap up warm: It's going to snow tonight, so remember to wrap up warm with a coat, a hat, and gloves.
今晚會下雪，所以記得戴上外套、帽子和手套，穿暖一點。
wreck a marriage: Constant lying and a lack of trust can wreck a marriage faster than money problems.
不斷說謊和缺乏信任，可能比金錢問題更快毀掉一段婚姻。
wreck one's chances: Cheating on the final exam could wreck your chances of getting into a good university.
期末考作弊可能會毀掉你進入好大學的機會。
wreck the economy: Experts warn that a long war could wreck the economy and leave millions of people without jobs.
專家警告，一場長期戰爭可能摧毀經濟，讓數百萬人失業。
a nervous wreck: Before her first job interview, Amy was a nervous wreck and couldn't sleep at all.
第一次工作面試前，艾咪緊張到崩潰，整晚完全睡不著。
wreck one's health: Staying up until three every night and skipping meals will completely wreck your health.
每晚熬夜到三點又不吃飯，會完全搞壞你的身體。
wreck a car: My cousin wrecked a car on his first day of driving when he hit a tree in the rain.
我表哥開車第一天，在雨中撞上一棵樹，撞毀了一輛車。
